title: Carrier Payment Route Raise on Mold Remediation Signing Deposits
content:
The carrier's proceeds reach the company only through the route the claim file's arrangement sets, and the Mold Remediation signing deposit follows that route. When the linked Insurance Claim Services claim file names a public adjuster, the deposit is raised by the adjuster route raise of 300.00; when the linked claim file names no public adjuster and its billing arrangement does not accept carrier payments issued directly to the company, the deposit is raised by the insured route raise of 200.00; a job with no linked claim file, or one whose arrangement accepts direct carrier payments and names no public adjuster, takes no route raise.

| Public adjuster named on the linked claim file | Arrangement accepts carrier payments issued directly to the company | Route raise |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 300.00 |
| Yes | No | 300.00 |
| No | No | 200.00 |
| No | Yes | None |
| No linked claim file | — | None |

**Records read.** The public adjuster named on the claim file the mold job is linked to, and whether that file's billing arrangement accepts carrier payments issued directly to the company.
